block.shhs_create_core.brass_ender_chest: _Copy_/_Paste_ the _owner_ and _lock state_ of the Brass Ender Chest.

An Ender Chest that can interact with _funnels_, _chutes_, _packagers_, and other _logistics components_. It can only access the Ender Chest _Inventory_ of its _owner_. If the owner is _offline_, the Brass Ender Chest _cannot be interacted with_.
block.shhs_create_core.hostility_absorbe: Higher speed increases the absorption radius up to config limit.
Restores all cleared chunks within the last radius.
A dynamic absorber that clears hostility from chunks based on rotational speed.
item.shhs_create_core.empty_trait.toolti: After _Charge_, _absorbs_ _one level_ of a random _Trait_ from the target and turns into its _Trait Item_.
An _Empty Vessel_ eager to absorb a little _Hostility_ from nearby creatures.
item.shhs_create_core.portable_stock_tic: If linked network exists and _is loaded_, opens a request menu.
If the target block is a _Stock Ticker_, _Stock Link_ or _Redstone Requester_, links to its network.
When used in Sneak on Blocks
Allows you to connect to a _Logistics Network_ and remotely view its stock information.
shhs_create_core.ponder.brass_ender_ches: Brass Ender Chest will automatically link to the placer's ender chest Inventory when it's placed.
Anyone who opens a Brass Ender Chest can only access its owner’s ender chest inventory.
When wearing Engineers' Goggles, players can see the owner and lock status of this Brass Ender Chest.
Owners can right-click the brass ender chest in sneaking to toggle its locked state.
When locked, only the owner can open the brass ender chest.
The clipboard can copy a Brass Ender Chest’s owner and lock status, then apply them to other Brass Ender Chests.
Use Brass Ender Chest to transit items
Brass Ender Chests can interact with logistics components.
Therefore, it can be used to streamline the logistics.
shhs_create_core.ponder.sprayer.facing.h: Impact of Sprayers' facing on their range
shhs_create_core.ponder.sprayer.facing.t: Sprayers facing different directions have different spray ranges.
shhs_create_core.ponder.sprayer.intro.te: The fluid's effect is applied to the front of the open pipe...
Sprayers can expand the fluid's effect to a larger area.
If the nozzle is blocked, sprayers will not operate.
Sprayers can also read the fluid from connected tanks directly.
shhs_create_core.ponder.sprayer.range.he: Controlling spray Range by adjusting the angle
shhs_create_core.ponder.sprayer.range.te: Spray range depends on their angle.
Their shaft input controls their angle.
When the angle is zero, sprayers will stop operating.
